# 部件与原理

_Components & Principles_

沿气流通道认识进气、风扇与压气机、涡轮和喷管，并关联循环、燃烧及控制。

_Follow the gas path through the inlet, fan, compressor, turbine and nozzle, and connect component behaviour to the cycle, combustion and control._

- [风扇与压气机 / Fans & Compressors](#books/wiki?page=205)

## 阅读建议 / Study Approach

先读专题导读，再查原始资料；把概念、工况和证据范围一起记录。

_Read the topic notes, then consult the original material. Keep concepts, operating conditions and the scope of evidence together._
